dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0640 is part of the ORCA (Japan Medical Association) open-source medical billing system.
evidence: COPY count 51, CALL count 50 typical of GnuCOBOL ORCA modules

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/claim processing) — inpatient diagnosis classification point aggregation (入院診療区分別点数集計)
purpose.summary: ORCR0640 is a large batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that aggregates and edits inpatient medical claim data by diagnosis/treatment category. It processes insurance billing records, calculates patient co-payment amounts, handles various regional public expense schemes, and prepares structured receipt (レセプト) output data. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2002–2007 covering numerous Japanese national health insurance rule changes.

notable_features: 880 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Fixed-format source with max line length 80
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
Long revision history with versioned change log (01.00.01 through 03.05.x)
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (garbled in latin-1 view). This is definitively part of the open-source JMA ORCA medical billing system, a well-known GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL production system used by Japanese medical clinics. Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is 874754 bytes / 18276 lines.
